hooks.name: Census on raw data created
hooks.description: When a file under data/raw/ is created, run npm run census (build-register, then rewrite the README census block). data/register.json is not under data/raw/, so the hook cannot trigger itself.

action.command: if out=$(npm run --silent census 2>&1); then printf "%s\n" "$out"; else echo "npm run census FAILED. README.md was left unchanged. Reason:" >&2; printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 1; fi

hooks.name: Census on raw data changed
hooks.description: Same as above, when a file under data/raw/ is saved.

action.command: if out=$(npm run --silent census 2>&1); then printf "%s\n" "$out"; else echo "npm run census FAILED. README.md was left unchanged. Reason:" >&2; printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 1; fi
